_comment: Template for a Change Card's machine-checkable half. Copy to
CHANGE-CARD-NNN.spec.json next to the card's .md and fill it in, then run
and paste the printed block into the card's PROOF OF DONE section.
This file exists because gatecheck.ts was written to read exactly this
shape and then NEVER GIVEN ONE: all 14 historical cards are .md only, so
the tool that 'assembles PROOF OF DONE' had no inputs and was never run.
rules:    which constitution rules this change touches. gatecheck knows
e2eSpecs: the committed Playwright specs that photograph the surfaces this
card changes. Required for any UI rule (R3/R6/R8/R9/R10) —
without them those rules report UNPROVEN, and UNPROVEN defaults
